facts.business: Hilton Metal Forging Limited manufactures and supplies forged components including railway wheels, defence components, turbine blades, and pipe fittings for sectors such as railways, defence, energy, and oil & gas.

segments.name: Defence components (forged empty artillery shells, precision-forged defence components)
Energy sector turbine components (forged turbine blades, critical turbine components)

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on dues to micro and small enterprises under MSMED Act, 2006; company has not made interest provision on late payment due to negotiation on accepted date and materials quality issues and rejection.
